name: colored
description: Demonstrates that terminal colours flow through the data model. Cases here render with ANSI colour forced ON (`input.color: true`); all other fixtures render with colour OFF for diffability. A cell carries a colour via {"text": "...", "style": "green"}; a whole column gets a default colour via the column's `style`; the header row + rule pick up the table's `header_style`. An explicit cell `style` overrides the column `style`. SGR codes: 1=bold, 2=dimmed, 31=red, 32=green, 33=yellow, 36=cyan, 0=reset.

cases.name: per-cell colours (running=green, stopped=red, degraded=yellow), a dimmed column, dimmed header + rule
